bell_1.mp3.name: bell
bell_1.mp3.prompt: One single toll of a big bronze bell in an old courthouse clock tower: struck once, deep and resonant, then ringing out with a long, slow, natural decay. Just the one strike, starting at once. Heard clearly from the town square, no echo of other bells, no clock ticking, no music, no voices, nothing else.
